sentences.en: Tears came into my eyes when I was chopping onions.
sentences.zh: 我在切洋葱的时候眼睛里涌出了泪水。

sentences.en: Garlic and onion are good remedies against the common cold.
sentences.zh: 大蒜和洋葱是治疗普通感冒的好药方。

sentences.en: Let me show you how to chop onions without crying.
sentences.zh: 让我来教你如何切洋葱而不流泪。

senses.zh: 洋葱(头) - (食物)洋葱, 葱头
